macros.name: countersmallbullet
macros.doc: It is intended that this macro typeset a character suitable for situations in which the “bullets” have to be grouped in a compact cluster; typically, this means that a smaller “bullet” is used than the one typeset by \counterlargebullet, although it is perfectly in order to use the same character in both situations.

macros.name: heartctrbull
macros.doc: This declaration causes little hearts (instead of bullets) to be used for all values from 1 to 9.

macros.name: largectrbull
macros.doc: This declaration causes (relatively) “large” bullets to be used for all values from 1 to 9.

macros.name: smallctrbull
macros.doc: This declaration causes “small” bullets to be used for all values from 1 to 9.

macros.name: smartctrbull
macros.doc: This declaration causes (relatively) “large” bullets to be used for values from 1 to 5 (inclusive), and “small” bullets for values equal to or above 6.
